model_annotation: The image displays a set of three side-by-side pie charts illustrating the proportional breakdown of different analytical categories: "Categorical," "Approximate Number Generation," and "Disjunctive &Conjunctive." None of the charts use a separate legend or feature exploded slices; instead, bolded text labels with precise percentages are centered directly within each segment. The first chart, titled "Categorical," is divided into four slices: "Universal Quantifiers" in light blue-grey (29.07%), "Limiter" in light pink (27.91%), "Negation" in pale orange (27.91%), and "Existential Quantifiers" in pale green (15.12%). The middle chart, "Approximate Number Generation," consists of three slices that appear visually arranged in descending size clockwise starting from the right: "Approximate Quantities" in pale yellow-beige (45.03%), "Comparative Relationships" in light blue (36.26%), and "Absolute Absence" in light purple (18.71%). The final chart, "Disjunctive &Conjunctive," is composed of two nearly equal halves: "Conjunctive" in pale pink (50.49%) positioned on the right and "Disjunctive" in pale blue-grey (49.51%) located on the left.
